def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    net_income = 1_500_000
    common_shares_outstanding = 1_000_000
    convertible_shares = 300_000
    bond_par_value = 10_000_000
    bond_coupon_rate = 0.04
    preferred_stock_par_value = 2_000_000
    preferred_dividend_rate = 0.07
    tax_rate = 0.30

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    preferred_dividends = preferred_stock_par_value * preferred_dividend_rate
    interest_on_bonds = bond_par_value * bond_coupon_rate
    after_tax_interest = interest_on_bonds * (1 - tax_rate)

    adjusted_net_income = (
        net_income - preferred_dividends + after_tax_interest
    )
    total_shares = common_shares_outstanding + convertible_shares
    diluted_eps = adjusted_net_income / total_shares

    # return answer
    return round(diluted_eps, 3)
